name: redsteep
description: Personal collection of Claude Code skills and plugins

plugins.name: pr-when-done
plugins.description: A finished branch ends up in a PR: a clean worktree ahead of the default branch with no PR gets one nudge per commit to review and open it.

plugins.name: spec-delta
plugins.description: Design specs list their Delta — every new name, one line each — so a review can subtract the diff from it. A hook blocks new specs that miss a template section.

plugins.name: review-mode
plugins.description: While you read a PR, Claude answers questions and runs things but queues change requests instead of editing. Turns on automatically after `gh pr create`.

plugins.name: instruction-feedback
plugins.description: When you correct Claude's implementation, it fixes the code and proposes the one-line instruction change that would have prevented it.

plugins.name: nightly-backlog
plugins.description: Unattended night run: takes one allowed tech-debt item (GitHub issues by default, any backlog via the profile) to a PR — a draft only while a gate stays open — proposes markings for a few more, and notifies through a project-defined command.

plugins.name: pre-pr-review
plugins.description: Gated review of a finished feature branch before the PR: surface vs the spec, E2E, architecture, test strategy, mutation testing, refactor. Blocks `gh pr create` until the review has run.

plugins.name: design-review
plugins.description: Adversarial review of a proposed design against the code it lands in — seven named tests from DDD and SOLID, read as a slice across every layer. Before implementation on the spec, and again on the branch to catch drift.
